Mechanologist Item (ArcaneRising). Two abilities: (1) Action - {r}: If no steam counters, put a steam counter on it. Go again. (2) Once per Turn Attack Reaction - Remove a steam counter: Target attack action card gains 'When this hits, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck.'

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it would be a defect.

ABILITY 1: ACTIVATE with activation_cost 1 (the {r} cost). Condition COUNTER_EQ steam 0 gates 'If there are no steam counters'. Effect PUT_COUNTER steam 1. The condition is at ability level (checked at resolution), matching 'If...' conditional effect wording.

ABILITY 2: ATTACK_REACTION with per_turn 1 for 'Once per Turn'. Cost REMOVE_COUNTERS steam 1. Target filter ATTACK_TYPE_IN Action + ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN Attack together name exactly an attack action card (condition_types.py:273/296). Effect INJECT_TRIGGER scope COMBAT (current attack only) with nested ON_HIT trigger granting PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK. The nested trigger dict is REQUIRED - a top-level conditions key would be popped by the loader as an effect-level gate evaluated once at registration (effect_types.py:2103-2119). PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK moves the attacking card to its owner's deck bottom (effect_types.py:1633-1654).
